The Breaking Point#000.src: Hey, keep up! We need to get this part into the machine as quickly as we can!
The Breaking Point#000.dst: ¡Eh, sígueme! Hay que meter esta pieza en la máquina cuanto antes.

The Breaking Point#001.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to Kandon Beda with that capacitor as quick as possible.
The Breaking Point#001.dst: ¡Increíble! Nos llevaré de vuelta a Kandon Beda con ese condensador lo antes posible.

The Breaking Point#002.src: I... see. {u}... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#002.dst: Ya... veo. {u}... Ozoth me dice... que una Llama Eterna... liberará a los Ancianos.

The Breaking Point#003.src: You need to get onto the path up to {p}. There should be signposts outside of {p}...
The Breaking Point#003.dst: Tienes que tomar el camino que sube a {p}. Debería haber señales fuera de {p}...

The Breaking Point#004.src: Speak to General Elix at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] in {p}.
The Breaking Point#004.dst: Habla con el General Elix en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], en {p}.

The Breaking Point#005.src: ... Alright, let's see here... Private! Give me a report!
The Breaking Point#005.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#006.src: Sir, our readings are postive! Stablility is at {~}, and shows no sign of dropping.
The Breaking Point#006.dst: ¡Señor, lecturas correctas! Estabilidad en {~}, sin señales de caída.
The Breaking Point#006.speaker: Private Walder

The Breaking Point#008.src: Excellent. Keep an eye on everything, and let me know if something comes up. Now, I need to go find...-
The Breaking Point#008.dst: Excelente. Vigilad todo y avisadme si surge algo. Ahora, tengo que ir a buscar...-
The Breaking Point#008.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#009.src: Hmph. And who exactly are you? This site is off-limits to civilians.
The Breaking Point#009.dst: Hmf. ¿Y tú quién eres? Esta zona está vetada a los civiles.
The Breaking Point#009.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#010.src: Adventurer. Of course. Well, as it stands, we're doing rather dangerous work here. I'll have to ask you to-
The Breaking Point#010.dst: Aventurero. Cómo no. Bueno, aquí hacemos un trabajo bastante peligroso. Tendré que pedirte que-
The Breaking Point#010.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#011.src: ... The stabilizer? We're doing rather dangerous work here, keeping the thing beyond that cliff passive. So, I'll have to ask you to-
The Breaking Point#011.dst: ... ¿El estabilizador? Aquí hacemos algo peligroso: mantener calmado a eso que hay tras el acantilado. Tendré que pedirte que-
The Breaking Point#011.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#012.src: General! Stability is dropping, and fast!
The Breaking Point#012.speaker: Private Walder

The Breaking Point#014.src: What?! Of all times for it to-
The Breaking Point#014.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#015.src: Urgh... Soldiers, follow protocol! Secure what you can, and leave what you can't! And- you! I haven't forgotten about you. As soon as this all cleans up, we'll-
The Breaking Point#015.dst: Urgh... ¡Soldados, el protocolo! ¡Salvad lo que podáis, dejad lo demás! Y- ¡tú! No me olvido de ti. En cuanto esto se calme-
The Breaking Point#015.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#016.src: Gah! This damned Colossus! What I wouldn't give to...
The Breaking Point#016.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#017.src: ... It's over. Walder! Survey the damages to our equipment! Morec! Take count of injuries around the base, make sure everyone's safe!
The Breaking Point#017.dst: ... Se acabó. ¡Walder! ¡Evalúa los daños del equipo! ¡Morec! ¡Cuenta los heridos de la base y comprueba que todos estén bien!
The Breaking Point#017.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#019.src: General! We came as soon as we could- we were down in the library and the exit co- Oh. Wow.
The Breaking Point#019.dst: ¡General! Vinimos en cuanto pudimos- estábamos abajo en la biblioteca y la salida se- Ah. Vaya.

The Breaking Point#020.src: Well, Rhay, you're here now, yes? What do you think, can you fix it? We'll need to get it working before-
The Breaking Point#020.dst: Bien, Rhay, ya estás aquí, ¿no? ¿Qué me dices, puedes arreglarlo? Tiene que funcionar antes de que-
The Breaking Point#020.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#021.src: Can I- No, of course I can't fix it! Not on my own, especially since we don't have the proper equipment around here! Ugh, how long has it even been since last time?
The Breaking Point#021.dst: ¿Que si puedo- No, ¡claro que no puedo! Yo sola no, y menos sin el equipo adecuado. Uf, ¿cuánto ha pasado desde la última vez?
The Breaking Point#021.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#022.src: It has been... three days... give or take. Rhay... you know we can't keep-
The Breaking Point#022.dst: Han pasado... tres días... más o menos. Rhay... sabes que no podemos-

The Breaking Point#023.src: The stabilizer has been working so far, Ineos! It's some of the finest technology our province has had to offer, and it has been working!
The Breaking Point#023.dst: ¡El estabilizador ha funcionado hasta ahora, Ineos! Es de lo mejor que ha dado nuestra provincia, ¡y funcionaba!
The Breaking Point#023.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#024.src: Rhay, you know... as well as I do... that it is getting worse. The Protector is... growing resistant to... your machines. We need... a new plan.
The Breaking Point#024.dst: Rhay, sabes... igual que yo... que va a peor. El Protector... se vuelve resistente... a tus máquinas. Hace falta... otro plan.
The Breaking Point#024.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#025.src: Yes, well, as soon as you come up with one, I'll be glad to hear it! But so far, you've barely gotten anything-
The Breaking Point#025.dst: Sí, bueno, en cuanto se te ocurra uno, ¡encantada de oírlo! Pero hasta ahora apenas has-
The Breaking Point#025.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#028.src: ... Sorry. I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. General, to answer your question... The stabilizer itself is damaged, but you should have what's needed to repair it here.
The Breaking Point#028.dst: ... Perdona. Lo siento, no lo decía en serio. General, respondiendo a su pregunta... El estabilizador está dañado, pero aquí debería haber con qué repararlo.
The Breaking Point#028.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#029.src: The issue is that the controls look like they're fried! And we don't have any replacement parts stored here. We'll have to travel back to Corkus, and...
The Breaking Point#029.dst: ¡El problema es que los mandos parecen fritos! Y aquí no guardamos piezas de repuesto. Habrá que volver a Corkus, y...
The Breaking Point#029.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#030.src: ... Right. You. You're an adventurer, yes? And you appear to be well-equipped. Then you'll be traveling to Corkus with Rhay, and assist with whatever is needed there.
The Breaking Point#030.dst: ... Bien. Tú. Eres aventurero, ¿no? Y pareces bien equipado. Entonces irás a Corkus con Rhay y ayudarás en lo que haga falta allí.
The Breaking Point#030.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#032.src: Wait, General-... Right. Alright. In that case... I'll give you time to prepare. We'll take the Hot Air Balloon to travel to Corkus, so I'll meet you there. We don't have any time to waste.
The Breaking Point#032.dst: Espere, General-... Ya. Está bien. En ese caso... te daré tiempo para prepararte. Iremos a Corkus en el globo aerostático; te veo allí. No hay tiempo que perder.
The Breaking Point#032.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#033.src: And I will... return to the library. I trust... you will succeed... But we must... prepare for the... worst.
The Breaking Point#033.dst: Y yo... volveré a la biblioteca. Confío... en que lo lograréis... Pero hay que... prever lo... peor.
The Breaking Point#033.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#035.src: Meet Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#035.dst: Reúnete con Rhay en el globo aerostático en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#036.src: Ah, you're here! Well, if you're ready, then we'd best be off. Just hop aboard this balloon, and the captain will take us where we need to go.
The Breaking Point#036.dst: ¡Ah, ya estás aquí! Si estás listo, más vale que salgamos. Sube al globo y el capitán nos llevará adonde hace falta.
The Breaking Point#036.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#037.src: I can tell you more while we travel, but we need to get going quick. There's no telling how much time we have before-
The Breaking Point#037.dst: Te cuento más por el camino, pero hay que salir ya. No sabemos cuánto tiempo queda antes de que-
The Breaking Point#037.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#038.src: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
The Breaking Point#038.dst: Ya, ya. No me hagas caso, estoy algo tensa por... bueno, razones obvias. Tú sube.
The Breaking Point#038.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#039.src: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, for obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
The Breaking Point#039.dst: Ya, ya. No me hagas caso, estoy un poco tensa por... bueno, por razones obvias. Tú sube.
The Breaking Point#039.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#040.src: Travel to {p} via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#040.dst: Viaja a {p} en el globo aerostático de [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#041.src: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all our problems here at {p}.
The Breaking Point#041.dst: ¡Ahí está! El Canyon Colossus en persona. El origen de todos nuestros problemas en {p}.
The Breaking Point#041.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#042.src: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all of our problems here at {p}.
The Breaking Point#042.dst: ¡Ahí lo tienes! El Canyon Colossus en persona. El origen de todos nuestros problemas aquí en {p}.
The Breaking Point#042.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#043.src: So! How much do you already know? I know we dragged you into this without telling you much, so... I can fill you in on the details.
The Breaking Point#043.dst: ¡Bien! ¿Cuánto sabes ya? Sé que te metimos en esto sin contarte gran cosa, así que... puedo darte los detalles.
The Breaking Point#043.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#044.src: Oh, he did? Right, that makes sense. Well, you're right in that it's the source of the earthquakes, but there's more to it than that.
The Breaking Point#044.dst: ¿Ah, sí? Ya, tiene sentido. Bueno, aciertas en que es el origen de los terremotos, pero hay más.
The Breaking Point#044.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#045.src: You've seen the {p}, right? Heard of the Fracturing. From what I can tell, what happened to that region a thousand years ago is happening again, here and now.
The Breaking Point#045.dst: Has visto {p}, ¿verdad? Y has oído hablar de la Fractura. Por lo que veo, lo que le pasó a esa región hace mil años vuelve a pasar, aquí y ahora.
The Breaking Point#045.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#046.src: Yes, exactly. It's been malfunctioning for a long time now, and it's starting to tear the canyon apart. That's where we come in.
The Breaking Point#046.dst: Sí, exacto. Lleva mucho tiempo fallando y está empezando a partir el cañón en dos. Ahí entramos nosotros.
The Breaking Point#046.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#047.src: Well... To start with, it's an ancient thing. It was built long before even the doguns can remember, and they've lived in this region for thousands of years.
The Breaking Point#047.dst: Bueno... Para empezar, es algo antiquísimo. Lo construyeron antes de lo que recuerdan los Doguns, y ellos llevan milenios aquí.
The Breaking Point#047.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#048.src: According to Ineos, the doguns used to be responsible for keeping it calm, but ever since the dwarves came in and started their war, that knowledge has been lost to time.
The Breaking Point#048.dst: Según Ineos, antes eran los Doguns quienes lo mantenían calmado, pero desde que llegaron los enanos y empezaron su guerra, ese saber se perdió.
The Breaking Point#048.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#049.src: Which is... a problem! {p} has been malfunctioning for hundreds of years, and it's reaching its breaking point. If we don't stop it, it'll tear the canyon apart.
The Breaking Point#049.dst: Lo cual es... ¡un problema! {p} lleva siglos fallando y llega a su punto de quiebre. Si no lo paramos, partirá el cañón en dos.
The Breaking Point#049.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#050.src: Oh? So you've traveled the canyon, then. Yeah, then you've seen how the canyon twists and changes.
The Breaking Point#050.dst: ¿Ah, sí? Así que has recorrido el cañón. Ya, entonces has visto cómo se retuerce y cambia.
The Breaking Point#050.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#051.src: It destroys peoples' homes, it traps them deep within the maze-like valleys... And, more recently, it has been tearing a hole into the void.
The Breaking Point#051.dst: Destruye hogares, atrapa a la gente en lo hondo de esos valles laberínticos... Y hace poco ha empezado a abrir un agujero al Vacío.
The Breaking Point#051.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#052.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try to keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#052.dst: Esa cosa es antiquísima y no sabemos cómo funciona. Lo máximo que podemos hacer es evitar que llegue a su punto de quiebre y que el cañón acabe como {p}.
The Breaking Point#052.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#053.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try and keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#053.dst: Esa cosa es antiquísima y no sabemos cómo funciona. Lo más que podemos hacer es tratar de evitar su punto de quiebre y que el cañón acabe como {p}.
The Breaking Point#053.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#054.src: So, Gavel's government contacted us in Corkus some time ago, requesting our help to deal with this threat.
The Breaking Point#054.dst: Hace un tiempo, el gobierno de Gavel nos contactó en Corkus para pedir ayuda con esta amenaza.
The Breaking Point#054.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#055.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified that Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#055.dst: Nuestro consejo aceptó y nos pusimos a diseñar una máquina que imitara la magia Dogun que apaciguó a ese Colossus hace mucho.
The Breaking Point#055.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#056.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified the Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#056.dst: Nuestro consejo aceptó y nos pusimos a diseñar una máquina capaz de imitar la magia Dogun que apaciguó al Colossus hace siglos.
The Breaking Point#056.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#057.src: We've had Ineos' help on that front. He and I have been working here in {p} to ensure things are running smoothly. Which... evidently, they are not.
The Breaking Point#057.dst: En eso nos ha ayudado Ineos. Él y yo trabajamos aquí en {p} para que todo marche bien. Cosa que... está claro que no.
The Breaking Point#057.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#058.src: ... We'll be fine! We're going to meet up with my husband at Corkus, and he'll know what to do. He always does.
The Breaking Point#058.dst: ... ¡Estaremos bien! Vamos a reunirnos con mi marido en Corkus, y él sabrá qué hacer. Siempre lo sabe.
The Breaking Point#058.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#059.src: Our people there will be able to get us the parts we need to repair the device. This... this isn't the first it's exploded. I had hoped that this time we would have gotten it stable, but...
The Breaking Point#059.dst: Los nuestros de allí conseguirán las piezas para reparar el aparato. Esta... no es la primera vez que estalla. Esperaba que esta vez lo hubiéramos estabilizado, pero...
The Breaking Point#059.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#060.src: But, hey! We have it under control. We're always able to repair it quickly enough to keep it running while the Colossus is active.
The Breaking Point#060.dst: ¡Pero oye! Lo tenemos controlado. Siempre logramos repararlo a tiempo para que siga en marcha mientras el Colossus está activo.
The Breaking Point#060.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#061.src: Oh! Yeah. He's the one responsible for the design and production of this device. He's got a talent for designing these sorts of things, without him... well, we'd be in a much worse situation than we are now.
The Breaking Point#061.dst: ¡Ah! Sí. Él es quien se encargó del diseño y la fabricación del aparato. Tiene un talento especial para diseñar estas cosas; sin él... bueno, estaríamos mucho peor de lo que estamos.
The Breaking Point#061.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#062.src: I'll be glad to see him again. It's been a while since I last had to travel to Corkus, and... Well, I'm confident he'll know what to do here. He always does.
The Breaking Point#062.dst: Me alegrará volver a verlo. Hacía tiempo que no tenía que viajar a Corkus, y... Bueno, seguro que él sabrá qué hacer aquí. Siempre lo sabe.
The Breaking Point#062.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#063.src: ... Right! Hey, it looks like we're almost there. We'll be able to get this all sorted out, and we'll be back to {p} in no time.
The Breaking Point#063.dst: ... ¡Bien! Oye, parece que casi hemos llegado. Arreglaremos todo esto y estaremos de vuelta en {p} en nada.
The Breaking Point#063.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#064.src: Find the contact in the factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#064.dst: Encuentra al contacto en la fábrica en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#065.src: Alright, let's just head on in. My husband should be around here somewhere...
The Breaking Point#065.dst: Bien, entremos sin más. Mi marido debe de andar por aquí...
The Breaking Point#065.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#066.src: Rhay, love! You're back already? Our next routine maitenance isn't for another- Wait, {u}? What are you doing here?
The Breaking Point#066.dst: ¡Rhay, cariño! ¿Ya has vuelto? El próximo mantenimiento no toca hasta- Espera, ¿{u}? ¿Qué haces tú aquí?
The Breaking Point#066.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#067.src: I... You two know each other?
The Breaking Point#067.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#068.src: Of course we do - they're the one who helped me with all the Factory stuff! How did you two meet?
The Breaking Point#068.dst: ¡Claro que sí - fue quien me ayudó con todo lo de la fábrica! ¿Cómo os conocisteis vosotros?
The Breaking Point#068.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#069.src: They just showed up at {p} and agreed to help us with... - Why didn't you bring this up earlier?
The Breaking Point#069.dst: Apareció en {p} sin más y accedió a ayudarnos con... - ¿Por qué no lo dijiste antes?
The Breaking Point#069.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#070.src: It must have...- right. Well, if anything that makes you even more qualified to help us out, I guess! I can't believe I didn't recognize you...?
The Breaking Point#070.dst: Debió de...- ya. Bueno, ¡supongo que eso te hace aún más capaz de ayudarnos! ¿Cómo no te reconocí...?
The Breaking Point#070.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#071.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maitenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#071.dst: Vale, bien, volvamos a la pregunta - ¿qué hacéis aquí ya? Aún faltan unos días para el próximo mantenimiento, ¿no?
The Breaking Point#071.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#072.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maintenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#072.dst: Vale, bien, volvamos a la pregunta - ¿qué hacéis aquí tan pronto? Todavía faltan unos días para el próximo mantenimiento, ¿verdad?
The Breaking Point#072.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#073.src: I did send you an invite! I gave it to... you know, that that one captain who ferries people around! But then you didn't show up to the wedding, so I guess it didn't reach you...
The Breaking Point#073.dst: ¡Sí que te mandé invitación! Se la di a... ya sabes, ese capitán que lleva gente de un lado a otro. Pero no apareciste en la boda, así que supongo que no te llegó...
The Breaking Point#073.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#074.src: Look, you're a hard person to reach! You've been all over the world at this point, including {p} of all places- speaking of, why are you two here?
The Breaking Point#074.dst: ¡Mira, no hay quien te localice! Has recorrido medio mundo, hasta {p} nada menos- por cierto, ¿a qué habéis venido?
The Breaking Point#074.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#076.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an undetected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#076.dst: ¡Sí! Sí. Me he ido un poco del tema... Eh, tenemos un problema allá en {p}. Hubo un seísmo que no detectamos y el aparato quedó muy dañado.
The Breaking Point#076.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#077.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an unexpected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#077.dst: ¡Sí! Sí. Me he despistado un momento... Eh, tenemos un problema allá en {p}. Hubo un seísmo inesperado y el aparato quedó muy dañado.
The Breaking Point#077.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#078.src: We should be able to finish most of the repairs with what materials we have there, but we're missing a Magmaflux Capacitor for the control panel.
The Breaking Point#078.dst: Casi todas las reparaciones las podemos hacer con lo que hay allí, pero nos falta un condensador Magmaflux para el panel de control.
The Breaking Point#078.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#079.src: ... Oh. That's going to be a problem. We haven't had an opportunity to make more parts yet - it hasn't been long enough since our last maitenance. So... I'm not sure what we-
The Breaking Point#079.dst: ... Ah. Eso va a ser un problema. Aún no hemos tenido ocasión de fabricar más piezas: hace muy poco del último mantenimiento. Así que... no sé muy bien qué-
The Breaking Point#079.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#080.src: I overheard the conversation from over there- good to see you Rhay, by the way- But. We may not have any capacitors left up here, but I know where you can get one.
The Breaking Point#080.dst: He oído la conversación desde allí- me alegro de verte, Rhay, por cierto- Pero. Puede que aquí arriba no queden condensadores, pero sé dónde conseguir uno.
The Breaking Point#080.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#081.src: We repurposed this factory for our needs, but it was built here to process resources from the mines below.
The Breaking Point#081.dst: Adaptamos esta fábrica a lo nuestro, pero se construyó para procesar los recursos de las minas de abajo.
The Breaking Point#081.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#082.src: Though it was discontinued, it's still very likely that there are still miner mechs down there- and some of the more powerful models made use of very similar circuits to the capacitors we use today.
The Breaking Point#082.dst: Aunque se abandonó, es muy probable que ahí abajo queden mechs mineros- y los modelos más potentes usaban circuitos muy parecidos a los condensadores de hoy.
The Breaking Point#082.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#083.src: ... You're right! If they're still down there, we should be able to scrap one of the bots and reuse its circuits. {u}, we can send you down into the mines to find what we need, while we prepare up here!
The Breaking Point#083.dst: ... ¡Tienes razón! Si siguen ahí abajo, podemos desguazar uno de los bots y reaprovechar sus circuitos. {u}, te mandamos a las minas a buscar lo que necesitamos mientras preparamos todo aquí arriba.
The Breaking Point#083.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#084.src: Alright... Good luck down there! Find the bot, destroy it, and bring the capacitor back up! Just step on the platform in the middle of the factory when you're ready.
The Breaking Point#084.dst: Vale... ¡Suerte ahí abajo! Encuentra el bot, destrúyelo y sube el condensador. Cuando estés listo, súbete a la plataforma del centro de la fábrica.
The Breaking Point#084.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#085.src: Okay. That's fine, just make it quick! You know we can't waste any time here.
The Breaking Point#085.dst: Vale. Bien, ¡pero date prisa! Sabes que no hay tiempo que perder.
The Breaking Point#085.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#086.src: Retrieve the part from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#086.dst: Consigue la pieza en la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#092.src: DIVERTING ALL AVAILABLE UNITS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#092.dst: DESVIANDO TODAS LAS UNIDADES PARA DETENER AL INTRUSO.
The Breaking Point#092.speaker: Mining Robots

The Breaking Point#093.src: THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA. REQUESTING AUTHORISATION FOR USE OF LETHAL FORCE AGAINST INTRUDER...
The Breaking Point#093.dst: ZONA RESTRINGIDA. SOLICITANDO AUTORIZACIÓN PARA USO DE FUERZA LETAL CONTRA EL INTRUSO...
The Breaking Point#093.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#095.src: DIVERTING MINER MECHS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#095.dst: DESVIANDO MECHS MINEROS PARA DETENER AL INTRUSO.
The Breaking Point#095.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#096.src: Return to the hot air balloon at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the Magmaflux Capacitor.
The Breaking Point#096.dst: Vuelve al globo aerostático en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] con el condensador Magmaflux.

The Breaking Point#097.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to {p} with that capacitor as quick as possible.
The Breaking Point#097.dst: ¡Buen trabajo! Nos llevaré a {p} con el condensador cuanto antes.
The Breaking Point#097.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#098.src: Good to see you again, {u}. Good luck with the colossus. And Rhay... come home as soon as you can.
The Breaking Point#098.dst: Me alegro de verte, {u}. Suerte con el Colossus. Y Rhay... vuelve a casa en cuanto puedas.
The Breaking Point#098.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#100.src: Return to General Elix with the Corkian Stabiliser
The Breaking Point#100.dst: Lleva el estabilizador corkiano al General Elix

The Breaking Point#101.src: Well... that went better than expected, really. I still can't believe you didn't tell me you already knew Maxie.
The Breaking Point#101.dst: Bueno... salió mejor de lo esperado, la verdad. Aún no me creo que no me dijeras que ya conocías a Maxie.
The Breaking Point#101.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#102.src: Oh, wow. It looks like they've managed to fix up the machine pretty well, all things considered. Just this part left to get it running again...
The Breaking Point#102.dst: Ah, vaya. Parece que han dejado la máquina bastante bien, teniendo en cuenta todo. Solo falta esta pieza para que vuelva a funcionar...
The Breaking Point#102.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#103.src: Hmph. Rhay, there you are. Seeing as you've returned, I gather everything went smoothly at Corkus?
The Breaking Point#103.dst: Hmf. Rhay, ahí estás. Ya que has vuelto, ¿todo fue bien en Corkus?
The Breaking Point#103.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#104.src: Smoothly enough, General! We have what we need to repair the control panel. We'll be able to get the stabilizer running again!
The Breaking Point#104.dst: ¡Bastante bien, General! Tenemos lo necesario para reparar el panel de control. ¡Podremos poner en marcha el estabilizador otra vez!
The Breaking Point#104.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#105.src: Well?! What are you waiting for? Finish the repairs, we can't afford to lose any time with this damned Colossus looming over us.
The Breaking Point#105.dst: ¿¡Y bien!? ¿A qué esperáis? Acabad las reparaciones; no podemos perder tiempo con ese maldito Colossus encima de nosotros.
The Breaking Point#105.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#106.src: Yes, sir! Alright. {u}, just slot the capacitor in right... there. I'll make sure it runs smoothly.
The Breaking Point#106.dst: ¡Sí, señor! Bien. {u}, encaja el condensador justo... ahí. Yo vigilo que funcione bien.
The Breaking Point#106.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#107.src: There we are. Now, let's get this thing running again! Walder, keep an eye on stability! And... Rhay. You're confident this will work?
The Breaking Point#107.dst: Ya está. ¡Ahora, a poner esto en marcha otra vez! ¡Walder, vigila la estabilidad! Y... Rhay. ¿Estás segura de que funcionará?
The Breaking Point#107.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#108.src: I-I'm sure. This is our last chance. We have to hold out hope that the stabilizer will hold.
The Breaking Point#108.dst: S-sí, segura. Es nuestra última oportunidad. Hay que confiar en que el estabilizador aguante.
The Breaking Point#108.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#109.src: Alright, alright... It's now or never... Hold, stabilizer, hold!
The Breaking Point#109.dst: Vale, vale... Ahora o nunca... ¡Aguanta, estabilizador, aguanta!
The Breaking Point#109.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#110.src: ... Oh. That's... that's it, then. It's over. We failed.
The Breaking Point#110.dst: ... Ah. Pues... pues ya está. Se acabó. Hemos fallado.
The Breaking Point#110.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#111.src: I... am sorry, Rhay. I had... hoped it would work. In truth... I do not have... a plan... either.
The Breaking Point#111.dst: Lo... siento, Rhay. Esperaba... que funcionara. La verdad... es que yo tampoco... tengo... un plan.
The Breaking Point#111.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#112.src: The Elders... would have known... what to do... But they are... long gone. Nothing but... ruins remain.
The Breaking Point#112.dst: Los Ancianos... habrían sabido... qué hacer... Pero hace mucho... que no están. Solo quedan... ruinas.
The Breaking Point#112.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#113.src: The Elders... They were... the greatest... of doguns. As old... as the oldest stones... and wise... as the earth itself...
The Breaking Point#113.dst: Los Ancianos... Eran... los más grandes... de los Doguns. Viejos... como las piedras más antiguas... y sabios... como la propia tierra...
The Breaking Point#113.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#114.src: They were capable... of magic... beyond what any... of us could achieve. They alone... could calm our... Protector.
The Breaking Point#114.dst: Su magia... superaba... cuanto ninguno... de nosotros logra. Solo ellos... calmaban al... Protector.
The Breaking Point#114.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#115.src: They were... sealed away. Frozen in... the deepest... of ice. When the dwarves... slew Garaheth... the Elders... fell with him.
The Breaking Point#115.dst: Fueron... sellados. Congelados en... el hielo más... profundo. Cuando los enanos... mataron a Garaheth... los Ancianos... cayeron con él.
The Breaking Point#115.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#116.src: Such atrocities... The war... My people... But it is not... to dwell on, now. There are... more important... things at hand.
The Breaking Point#116.dst: Qué atrocidades... La guerra... Mi pueblo... Pero no es... momento de pensar en eso. Hay cosas... más urgentes... entre manos.
The Breaking Point#116.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#117.src: I... I did not... know of this. My people... are free? How long... has it been... since I have seen... my home?
The Breaking Point#117.dst: Yo... no... sabía nada de esto. ¿Mi pueblo... es libre? ¿Cuánto hace... que no veo... mi hogar?
The Breaking Point#117.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#118.src: You... Adventurer. We must... speak to my people. Our chieftain... will know... how we may free... the Elders.
The Breaking Point#118.dst: Tú... Aventurero. Hablemos... con mi pueblo. Nuestro jefe... sabrá... cómo liberar... a los Ancianos.
The Breaking Point#118.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#119.src: If there's a chance... We have to take it. Ineos, {u}, take the balloon. We'll do what we can here. Now, go! There's no time to waste!
The Breaking Point#119.dst: Si hay una posibilidad... hay que tomarla. Ineos, {u}, coged el globo. Aquí haremos lo que podamos. ¡Id ya! ¡No hay tiempo que perder!
The Breaking Point#119.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#120.src: It looks like Ozoth's body is trying to prevent you from getting the Everflame!
The Breaking Point#120.dst: ¡El cuerpo de Ozoth intenta impedir que cojas la Llama Eterna!

The Breaking Point#121.src: Meet Ineos and Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Breaking Point#121.dst: Reúnete con Ineos y Rhay en el globo aerostático en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Breaking Point#122.src: I have never... seen the Heights... from above. I wonder... if their glow... holds the same strength... it does from below...
The Breaking Point#122.dst: Nunca había visto... las Heights... desde el aire. Me pregunto... si su resplandor... tiene la misma fuerza... que desde abajo...
The Breaking Point#122.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#123.src: I only hope... the Elders... are not gone... for good. We greatly need... their wisdom.
The Breaking Point#123.dst: Solo espero... que los Ancianos... no se hayan ido... para siempre. Necesitamos mucho... su sabiduría.
The Breaking Point#123.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#124.src: Ah... I believe us... to be landing...
The Breaking Point#124.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#125.src: Travel to {p} with Ineos via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#125.dst: Viaja a {p} con Ineos en el globo aerostático de [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#126.src: ... Hello. What a... strange sight... to see you landing... at our village... in such a contraption...
The Breaking Point#126.dst: ... Hola. Qué... extraña estampa... verte aterrizar... en nuestra aldea... en semejante artilugio...
The Breaking Point#126.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#127.src: And... is that... Ineos? We thought... the dwarves... had turned you into rubble...
The Breaking Point#127.dst: Y... ¿ese es... Ineos? Creíamos... que los enanos... te habían hecho escombros...
The Breaking Point#127.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#128.src: I escaped... It is a long... story, Korzim. We do not... have time. Where is... your father?
The Breaking Point#128.dst: Escapé... Es una larga... historia, Korzim. No tenemos... tiempo. ¿Dónde está... tu padre?
The Breaking Point#128.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#129.src: He is... below. They are... freeing the frozen... in New Taloka. Why do you... wish to speak... with him?
The Breaking Point#129.dst: Está... abajo. Están... liberando a los congelados... en New Taloka. ¿Para qué... quieres... verlo?
The Breaking Point#129.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#130.src: The Protector... is angered. We must find... the Elders. They will know... how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#130.dst: El Protector... está furioso. Debemos hallar... a los Ancianos. Ellos sabrán... cómo calmarlo.
The Breaking Point#130.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#131.src: The... Protector... I understand. I will... bring you two... to him. Sidio... Raetin... I leave you two... in charge.
The Breaking Point#131.dst: El... Protector... Entiendo. Os llevaré... a los dos... ante él. Sidio... Raetin... os dejo... al mando.
The Breaking Point#131.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#132.src: Now, let us travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#132.dst: Ahora, viajemos... entre llamas... y entre piedra...
The Breaking Point#132.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#133.src: Speak to {p}'s King and the Dogun Chieftain at New Taloka at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#133.dst: Habla con el rey de {p} y con el jefe Dogun en New Taloka, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#134.src: We are... here. Taloka was... one of the first to fall... in the war. We have been... working with the dwarves... to restore it.
The Breaking Point#134.dst: Ya... llegamos. Taloka fue... de las primeras en caer... en la guerra. Trabajamos... con los enanos... para restaurarla.
The Breaking Point#134.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#138.src: Very well. Begin on three. One... Two... Three!
The Breaking Point#138.dst: Muy bien. Empezad a la de tres. Uno... Dos... ¡Tres!
The Breaking Point#138.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#139.src: Beginning reheating cycle! Stand back from the subject.
The Breaking Point#139.speaker: Dwarven Technician

The Breaking Point#140.src: ... Where... am... I? How long... has it... been...?
The Breaking Point#140.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#141.src: ...Dwarf... You... you froze me... I will... I will...!
The Breaking Point#141.dst: ...Enano... Tú... tú me congelaste... Voy a... ¡voy a...!
The Breaking Point#141.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#142.src: Calm yourself... Delg. Our war... has ended. We are... freed. You have been... freed.
The Breaking Point#142.dst: Cálmate... Delg. Nuestra guerra... ha terminado. Somos... libres. Tú has sido... liberado.
The Breaking Point#142.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#143.src: ... Freedom? Hundreds... of years... of war... And we are... free?
The Breaking Point#143.dst: ... ¿Libertad? Cientos... de años... de guerra... ¿Y somos... libres?
The Breaking Point#143.speaker: Dogun Delg

The Breaking Point#144.src: Yes. We are free... to roam our home... once more. Edac... Escort Delg... and help him re-adjust... to the heights.
The Breaking Point#144.dst: Sí. Volvemos a ser libres... en casa. Edac... lleva a Delg... y ayúdale a volver... a las Heights.
The Breaking Point#144.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#145.src: Ah, {u}! It's good to see you again. We haven't seen you around here since... since the end of it.
The Breaking Point#145.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! Me alegro de verte otra vez. No te veíamos por aquí desde... desde que acabó todo.
The Breaking Point#145.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#146.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed bretheren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#146.dst: Sí. Hemos trabajado... sin descanso... estas últimas semanas. Taloka volverá... a alzarse pronto. Y muchos... de nuestros hermanos sellados... han vuelto a la vida.
The Breaking Point#146.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#147.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed brethren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#147.dst: Sí. Hemos trabajado... sin tregua... estas últimas semanas. Taloka pronto... volverá a alzarse. Y muchos... de nuestros hermanos sellados... han vuelto a la vida.
The Breaking Point#147.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#149.src: You use the grappling hook to swing back to the King in a dazzling feat of trapeze consisting of mid-air flips and acrobatic flourishes.
The Breaking Point#149.dst: Usas el gancho para volver hasta el rey en una deslumbrante exhibición de trapecio, con volteretas en el aire y florituras acrobáticas.

The Breaking Point#150.src: Ah, but we can talk more about that later. Tell me, what brings you here today? Is there something you need from us?
The Breaking Point#150.dst: Ah, pero de eso ya hablaremos luego. Dime, ¿qué te trae hoy por aquí? ¿Necesitas algo de nosotros?
The Breaking Point#150.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#151.src: The situtation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#151.dst: La situación... es grave. El Gran Protector... lleva demasiado tiempo... solo. Necesitamos... la sabiduría... de nuestros Ancianos. ¿Sabes... dónde están sellados?
The Breaking Point#151.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#152.src: The situation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#152.dst: La situación... es desesperada. El Gran Protector... ha estado solo... demasiado tiempo. Necesitamos... la sabiduría... de nuestros Ancianos. ¿Sabes... dónde los sellaron?
The Breaking Point#152.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#153.src: The Elders?! Yes, we know where they are sealed. However, retrieving them is no simple task. It would take us years to break past the defenses, and we have countless other doguns to release first.
The Breaking Point#153.dst: ¿¡Los Ancianos!? Sí, sabemos dónde están sellados. Pero sacarlos no es nada sencillo. Nos llevaría años romper las defensas, y antes hay incontables Doguns que liberar.
The Breaking Point#153.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#155.src: Ineos... I want our Elders free... as much as you do. But our Protector... has stood firm... for hundreds of years. It can stand... for another-
The Breaking Point#155.dst: Ineos... quiero ver libres a nuestros Ancianos... tanto como tú. Pero nuestro Protector... lleva siglos... firme. Puede aguantar... otro-
The Breaking Point#155.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#156.src: No... Has it truly... fallen this far..?
The Breaking Point#156.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#157.src: ... That was your Protector? How powerful is it, if it can reach this far?
The Breaking Point#157.dst: ... ¿Eso era vuestro Protector? ¿Cuán fuerte es, si llega hasta aquí?
The Breaking Point#157.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#158.src: If the Protector... could shake even the Heights... It could destroy... half of this province.
The Breaking Point#158.dst: Si el Protector... puede sacudir hasta las Heights... podría destruir... media provincia.
The Breaking Point#158.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#159.src: Draani... the Elders must be freed. They alone... would know how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#159.dst: Draani... hay que liberar a los Ancianos. Solo ellos... lo calmarán.
The Breaking Point#159.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#160.src: Yes... I understand. Very well. {u}, I will take you to the Elders' vault. I hold the keys to open the way forward. Paku, gather your people. See if anyone has alternative solutions.
The Breaking Point#160.dst: Sí... entiendo. Muy bien. {u}, te llevaré a la cámara de los Ancianos. Yo tengo las llaves que abren el camino. Paku, reúne a tu gente. Mira si alguien tiene otra solución.
The Breaking Point#160.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#161.src: We will... search for one. I cannot... promise that one exists.
The Breaking Point#161.dst: La buscaremos... Pero no puedo... prometer que exista.
The Breaking Point#161.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#162.src: {u}, let us go. It sounds as if we have very little time to waste.
The Breaking Point#162.dst: {u}, vamos. Parece que nos queda muy poco tiempo.
The Breaking Point#162.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#163.src: I will make preparations, and meet you at the Vault of Ice.
The Breaking Point#163.dst: Haré los preparativos y te veré en la Cámara de Hielo.
The Breaking Point#163.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#164.src: Enter the Dogun Vault within the lower Freezing Heights at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#164.dst: Entra en la Cámara Dogun de las Freezing Heights inferiores, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#165.src: ... Ahem. This is the entrance, then. One of our most closely guarded secrets... I was hoping not to have to confront this reminder for a while yet...
The Breaking Point#165.dst: ... Ejem. Esta es la entrada. Uno de nuestros secretos mejor guardados... Esperaba no tener que afrontar este recuerdo en un tiempo...
The Breaking Point#165.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#166.src: But it seems we don't have much choice now. I have the keys, let's go inside.
The Breaking Point#166.dst: Pero parece que ya no hay elección. Tengo las llaves; entremos.
The Breaking Point#166.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#167.src: Unlock the Dogun Vault to find the Elders.
The Breaking Point#167.dst: Abre la Cámara Dogun para encontrar a los Ancianos.

The Breaking Point#168.src: Rather cold in here, isn't it? A vault carved into a drake's True Ice... I suppose my ancestors hoped to seal these doguns in here forever. I'll be glad to disappoint them.
The Breaking Point#168.dst: Hace frío aquí, ¿eh? Una cámara tallada en el True Ice de un drake... Mis antepasados querían sellar aquí a estos Doguns para siempre. Me alegrará decepcionarlos.
The Breaking Point#168.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#169.src: Quickly, then, let us proceed to the primary door. I pray the Elders will be responsive to our situation with the Colossus.
The Breaking Point#169.dst: Rápido, pues, vayamos a la puerta principal. Ruego que los Ancianos atiendan a nuestra situación con el Colossus.
The Breaking Point#169.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#170.src: In any case... Let me see if I can open this second gate. It should be as simple as...
The Breaking Point#170.dst: En fin... Veamos si puedo abrir esta segunda puerta. Debería bastar con...
The Breaking Point#170.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#171.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I have never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#171.dst: Hm. Eso... no ha funcionado. Esta magia es antigua y nunca me tomé el tiempo de aprenderla bien... En fin. Hay alternativas.
The Breaking Point#171.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#172.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other side of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#172.dst: Si no me falla la memoria, debe de haber un mando manual al otro lado de esta sima.
The Breaking Point#172.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#173.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#173.dst: Hm. Eso... no ha funcionado. Esta magia es antigua y nunca saqué tiempo para aprenderla bien... En fin. Hay alternativas.
The Breaking Point#173.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other end of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#174.dst: Si no me falla la memoria, debe de haber un mando manual al otro extremo de esta sima.
The Breaking Point#174.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#176.src: The issue is that treacherous pool of lava on the way... and I don't think my knees are up to the task of jumping over it all.
The Breaking Point#176.dst: El problema es esa traicionera charca de lava del camino... y no creo que mis rodillas estén para saltarla entera.
The Breaking Point#176.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#177.src: I would never usually do this, but these are desperate times. Here, take my Trusty Grappling Hook. It should help you get over to the switch.
The Breaking Point#177.dst: Normalmente jamás haría esto, pero son tiempos desesperados. Toma, mi fiel Grappling Hook. Debería ayudarte a llegar al interruptor.
The Breaking Point#177.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#178.src: It has limitations, though. It will only be able to latch onto those blue rocks on the walls - and I'll be taking it back once you're finished, thank you very much!
The Breaking Point#178.dst: Eso sí, tiene sus límites. Solo se engancha a esas rocas azules de las paredes - ¡y me lo devolverás en cuanto termines, muchas gracias!
The Breaking Point#178.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#179.src: Hey, {u}! Looks like you're doing good so far, but if you get stuck remember you can jump and then grapple mid-air, that might help on some of those trickier platforms!
The Breaking Point#179.dst: ¡Eh, {u}! Parece que vas bien, pero si te atascas recuerda que puedes saltar y engancharte en el aire; eso ayuda en las plataformas más complicadas.
The Breaking Point#179.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#180.src: Looks like that unlocked it, {u}! Get yourself back over here and I'll open the door.
The Breaking Point#180.dst: ¡Parece que eso lo ha abierto, {u}! Vuelve aquí y abriré la puerta.
The Breaking Point#180.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#181.src: There we are! Excellent work. You used that hook like a true expert! Ah, reminds me of the time-...
The Breaking Point#181.dst: ¡Ahí está! Excelente. ¡Has usado ese gancho como todo un experto! Ah, me recuerda a cuando-...
The Breaking Point#181.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#182.src: ...Ahem. Excellent work, indeed. With the override activated, I should be able to do the rest of the work to open the gate.
The Breaking Point#182.dst: ...Ejem. Excelente trabajo, sin duda. Con el mando activado, yo debería poder hacer el resto para abrir la puerta.
The Breaking Point#182.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#183.src: First, though, I'll be having that grappling hook back! Think of what could happen if you had free reign of that all over.
The Breaking Point#183.dst: Pero antes, ¡me devuelves ese gancho! Piensa lo que podría pasar si lo usaras a tu antojo por ahí.
The Breaking Point#183.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#184.src: And so... I believe we have gone as far as we can.
The Breaking Point#184.dst: Y con esto... creo que hemos llegado hasta donde podíamos.
The Breaking Point#184.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#185.src: This is True Ice, {u}. It has scarred this part of the Heights for centuries, ever since it was created by an ice dragon in my ancestors' conquest.
The Breaking Point#185.dst: Esto es True Ice, {u}. Marca esta parte de las Heights desde que lo creó un dragón de hielo en la conquista de mis ancestros.
The Breaking Point#185.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#186.src: It cannot be melted or burned through by any means. It is why this location was chosen for their tomb. I'm afraid there is nothing more we can do.
The Breaking Point#186.dst: No hay forma de fundirlo ni de quemarlo. Por eso se eligió este lugar para su tumba. Me temo que no podemos hacer nada más.
The Breaking Point#186.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#187.src: At the end of the war, I imagine.
The Breaking Point#187.dst: Al final de la guerra, imagino.
The Breaking Point#187.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#188.src: As the final dogun settlements fell, and as Garaheth was slain for the first time, my ancestors must have sealed them deep in this ice.
The Breaking Point#188.dst: Cuando cayeron los últimos poblados Dogun y Garaheth murió por primera vez, mis ancestros debieron de sellarlos en lo hondo del hielo.
The Breaking Point#188.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#189.src: The... actions of the Dwarves after winning the war are well documented. I would not be surprised if our accounts describe this imprisonment as a great victory.
The Breaking Point#189.dst: Los... actos de los enanos tras ganar la guerra están bien documentados. No me extrañaría que nuestras crónicas describan este encierro como una gran victoria.
The Breaking Point#189.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#190.src: The Dwarves, of course. Who else?
The Breaking Point#190.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#191.src: I believe it was General Algard of the Dwarven army to order the Elders' imprisonments.
The Breaking Point#191.dst: Creo que fue el General Algard, del ejército enano, quien ordenó encerrar a los Ancianos.
The Breaking Point#191.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#192.src: He was lauded as a hero, naturally. Now... we must reap the consequences of such a decision.
The Breaking Point#192.dst: Lo aclamaron como un héroe, cómo no. Ahora... nos toca pagar las consecuencias de esa decisión.
The Breaking Point#192.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#193.src: True Ice is a material that cannot be melted or burned through by any means. Not even dogun magic has been able to make a dent.
The Breaking Point#193.dst: El True Ice es un material que no hay forma de fundir ni de quemar. Ni siquiera la magia Dogun ha logrado hacerle una muesca.
The Breaking Point#193.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#194.src: ... I imagine why this location was chosen to hold the elders. A prison from which they would never be able to escape.
The Breaking Point#194.dst: ... Me imagino por qué se eligió este lugar para retener a los Ancianos. Una prisión de la que jamás podrían escapar.
The Breaking Point#194.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#195.src: It is known for it to form naturally under extreme conditions... But the ice here is nowhere near natural.
The Breaking Point#195.dst: Se sabe que se forma solo en condiciones extremas... Pero este hielo no tiene nada de natural.
The Breaking Point#195.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#196.src: It was formed by an Ice Drake's Breath partway through the war- and, well, as you can see, it has remained here ever since.
The Breaking Point#196.dst: Lo formó el aliento de un Ice Drake a mitad de la guerra- y, bueno, como ves, aquí sigue desde entonces.
The Breaking Point#196.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#197.src: Just another remnant of our past mistakes, I suppose...
The Breaking Point#197.dst: Otro resto más de nuestros errores pasados, supongo...
The Breaking Point#197.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#198.src: Ahem. In any case- as I said, True Ice is impossible to break through, even with the most scorching flames.
The Breaking Point#198.dst: Ejem. En fin- como dije, el True Ice no se puede atravesar, ni con las llamas más abrasadoras.
The Breaking Point#198.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#199.src: I... I suppose that a dragon's breath might be able to melt it. That logic does make sense.
The Breaking Point#199.dst: Yo... supongo que el aliento de un dragón podría fundirlo. La lógica se sostiene.
The Breaking Point#199.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#200.src: We have little knowledge of what dragons were like, though. As they went extinct, that information became... useless. And so, it was lost.
The Breaking Point#200.dst: Aunque sabemos poco de cómo eran los dragones. Al extinguirse, esa información se volvió... inútil. Y así se perdió.
The Breaking Point#200.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#201.src: If anyone would know more about dragons, it would be the doguns.
The Breaking Point#201.dst: Si alguien sabe más de dragones, son los Doguns.
The Breaking Point#201.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#202.src: But none of that matters. All the dragons are gone, after all. We still have no options.
The Breaking Point#202.dst: Pero nada de eso importa. Al fin y al cabo, ya no quedan dragones. Seguimos sin opciones.
The Breaking Point#202.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#203.src: Why, they died out. As Gavellian civilizations grew in size, the ferocity and size of a dragon was simply too much of a threat.
The Breaking Point#203.dst: Pues se extinguieron. Al crecer las civilizaciones de Gavel, la ferocidad y el tamaño de un dragón eran una amenaza excesiva.
The Breaking Point#203.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#204.src: Some were hunted. Some died of starvation. Eggs were taken from nests and shattered over boulders for the birds to feed on.
The Breaking Point#204.dst: A unos los cazaron. Otros murieron de hambre. Los huevos se sacaban de los nidos y se estrellaban contra las rocas para las aves.
The Breaking Point#204.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#205.src: Now all that are left are dragonlings - echoes of their once-great ancestors, with barely enough flames to singe your armor.
The Breaking Point#205.dst: Ahora solo quedan dragoncillos - ecos de sus otrora grandes ancestros, con apenas llama para chamuscarte la armadura.
The Breaking Point#205.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#207.src: A living dragon... You've done quite a lot, haven't you? Stopped a war, moved a dragon...
The Breaking Point#207.dst: Un dragón vivo... Has hecho unas cuantas cosas, ¿eh? Parar una guerra, mover un dragón...
The Breaking Point#207.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#208.src: Well... if there is a living dragon at {p}... Then we still have hope! {u}, we must ask for its help.
The Breaking Point#208.dst: Bueno... si hay un dragón vivo en {p}... ¡aún hay esperanza! {u}, hay que pedirle ayuda.
The Breaking Point#208.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#209.src: Let us return to the others. I asked them to wait outside of {p}... perhaps they'll be able to confirm that a dragon's breath would do the job.
The Breaking Point#209.dst: Volvamos con los demás. Les pedí que esperaran fuera de {p}... quizá puedan confirmar que el aliento de un dragón serviría.
The Breaking Point#209.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#210.src: Indeed. The fire dragons that sided with them during the war. I'm sure you've come across the skeleton just outside Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#210.dst: Así es. Los dragones de fuego que se aliaron con ellos en la guerra. ¿Habrás visto el esqueleto junto a las Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#210.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#211.src: Yes, well... the Dwarves needed a counter to the sheer power of a fire dragon in battle, and so they resorted to enslaving dragons and drakes of other elements.
The Breaking Point#211.dst: Sí, bueno... los enanos necesitaban algo contra el puro poder de un dragón de fuego en combate, y acabaron esclavizando dragones y drakes de otros elementos.
The Breaking Point#211.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#212.src: Like the Ice Drake that created this vault, and encased the Elders in the truest of ice.
The Breaking Point#212.dst: Como el Ice Drake que creó esta cámara y encerró a los Ancianos en el hielo más puro.
The Breaking Point#212.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#213.src: ... Well, there was this excellent novel of about one of those creatures from the Shiar, who had to travel to the Heights with this ring he had inherited-
The Breaking Point#213.dst: ... Bueno, había una novela excelente sobre una de esas criaturas del Shiar, que tenía que viajar a las Heights con un anillo heredado-
The Breaking Point#213.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#214.src: But I confess, these questions seem almost irrelevant. We have a more pressing issue at hand, {u}.
The Breaking Point#214.dst: Pero confieso que estas preguntas sobran ahora. Tenemos algo más urgente entre manos, {u}.
The Breaking Point#214.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#215.src: This ice is harder than obsidian itself. The crystals which form the material are bonded by ancient magic.
The Breaking Point#215.dst: Este hielo es más duro que la obsidiana. Los cristales que lo forman están unidos por magia antigua.
The Breaking Point#215.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#216.src: Shattering it with such tools isn't an option. Perhaps there is a weapon that could break through, somewhere deep in our armory- after all, this vault had to be carved somehow...
The Breaking Point#216.dst: Romperlo con esas herramientas no es opción. Quizá haya un arma capaz de atravesarlo en lo hondo de nuestra armería- al fin y al cabo, esta cámara se talló de algún modo...
The Breaking Point#216.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#217.src: However, given the circumstances, I don't think we have the time to search for it. Even if we started now, our armory is enormous. It would take weeks to find what we need.
The Breaking Point#217.dst: Pero, dadas las circunstancias, no creo que tengamos tiempo de buscarla. Aunque empezáramos ya, nuestra armería es enorme. Tardaríamos semanas en dar con ello.
The Breaking Point#217.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#218.src: The lava of the Heights is nothing more than molten rock. Just a remnant of the shaping of these caverns.
The Breaking Point#218.dst: La lava de las Heights no es más que roca fundida. Un resto de cuando se formaron estas cavernas.
The Breaking Point#218.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#219.src: It's not nearly hot enough to melt True Ice. If it could, the Freezing Heights would have faded long ago.
The Breaking Point#219.dst: No arde ni de lejos lo bastante para fundir el True Ice. Si no, las Freezing Heights ya no existirían.
The Breaking Point#219.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#220.src: My... uhm... green is nice, I suppose? Though perhaps not very Dwarven...
The Breaking Point#220.dst: Eh... pues... el verde está bien, ¿no? Aunque poco propio de un enano...
The Breaking Point#220.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#221.src: Red, then. Or orange! ...Although my bedsheets are the most wonderful shade of navy blue...
The Breaking Point#221.dst: El rojo, entonces. ¡O el naranja! ...Aunque mis sábanas son de un azul marino maravilloso...
The Breaking Point#221.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#222.src: Breakfast... I had some eggs, I suppose. Though, I had no idea that breakfast would be my last, did I..?
The Breaking Point#222.dst: El desayuno... huevos, creo. Aunque no sabía que ese desayuno sería el último, ¿verdad..?
The Breaking Point#222.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#223.src: Hm... Had I known, maybe I would have chosen differently. Maybe I would have-... nevermind.
The Breaking Point#223.dst: Hm... De haberlo sabido, quizá habría elegido otra cosa. Quizá habría-... da igual.
The Breaking Point#223.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#224.src: Regroup at outside {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out how to free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#224.dst: Reagrúpate fuera de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], para decidir cómo liberar a los Ancianos.

The Breaking Point#225.src: ... so this is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#225.dst: ... así está la situación en la que nos encontramos. Paku, ¿tú qué opinas? ¿Funcionaría un plan así?
The Breaking Point#225.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#226.src: ... so that is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#226.dst: ... así es la situación en la que estamos. Paku, ¿tú qué opinas? ¿Funcionaría un plan así?
The Breaking Point#226.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#227.src: Hm... You may be correct... Draani. The magic in... a dragon's breath... was very potent. And to think... mighty Ozoth had survived... all these years...
The Breaking Point#227.dst: Hm... Quizá tengas razón... Draani. La magia... del aliento de dragón... era muy potente. Y la gran Ozoth... sigue viva... tras tantos años...
The Breaking Point#227.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#228.src: If Ozoth is alive... we must seek her help. If the doguns ask... for her aid, she will... give it.
The Breaking Point#228.dst: Si Ozoth vive... hemos de pedirle ayuda. Si los Doguns... se la piden, ella... la dará.
The Breaking Point#228.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#229.src: Well, that's as good a plan as any. {u}, you'll travel to seek this dragon's counsel, along with... Ineos, was it? Good luck.
The Breaking Point#229.dst: Bueno, es un plan tan bueno como otro. {u}, irás a buscar el consejo de esa dragona junto a... Ineos, ¿verdad? Suerte.
The Breaking Point#229.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#230.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I will put the coordinates... in your Quest Book.
The Breaking Point#230.dst: Toma... el túnel comercial... {u}. Pondré las coordenadas... en tu libro de misiones.
The Breaking Point#230.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#231.src: Use the {p} trading tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to travel to {p}.
The Breaking Point#231.dst: Usa el túnel comercial de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para viajar a {p}.

The Breaking Point#232.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] in an attempt to speak with her.
The Breaking Point#232.dst: Viaja a {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], e intenta hablar con ella.

The Breaking Point#233.src: Ah... it is... good to... see you. We must... proceed to Ozoth... with all haste.
The Breaking Point#233.dst: Ah... me alegra... verte. Debemos... ir... hacia Ozoth a toda prisa.
The Breaking Point#233.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#234.src: Ozoth the Dragon... Endless Kindler... we have come... to ask for your aid.
The Breaking Point#234.dst: Ozoth, la Dragona... Encendedora Sin Fin... venimos... a pedir ayuda.
The Breaking Point#234.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#236.src: We are searching... for a way... to melt the truest... of ice. The fate... of Gavel... hangs in the balance.
The Breaking Point#236.dst: Buscamos... un modo... de fundir el hielo... más puro. El destino... de Gavel... está en juego.
The Breaking Point#236.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#237.src: Doguns... and Dragons... our fates have been entwined... for centuries. We call on you now... Endless Kindler... to save this province.
The Breaking Point#237.dst: Doguns... y dragones... llevamos siglos... con el destino entrelazado. Te llamamos... Encendedora Sin Fin... salva esta provincia.
The Breaking Point#237.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#239.src: I... see. ... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#239.dst: Ya... veo. ... Ozoth dice... que una Llama Eterna... los liberará.
The Breaking Point#239.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#241.src: The Endless Kindler... is willing to part... with hers. You must... retrieve it... from her stomach.
The Breaking Point#241.dst: La Encendedora Sin Fin... está dispuesta a ceder... la suya. Debes... sacarla... de su estómago.
The Breaking Point#241.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#243.src: I would advise you... not to think... too much about this. When... you are ready... enter Ozoth's mouth and retrieve... the flame.
The Breaking Point#243.dst: Te aconsejo... no pensar... demasiado en esto. Cuando... estés listo... entra en la boca de Ozoth y saca... la llama.
The Breaking Point#243.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#244.src: Descend into Ozoth's belly to retrieve an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#244.dst: Desciende al vientre de Ozoth para conseguir una Llama Eterna.

The Breaking Point#245.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] with an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#245.dst: Viaja a {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], con una Llama Eterna.

The Breaking Point#246.src: {u}! Have you retrieved... the Eternal Flame?
The Breaking Point#246.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#248.src: Excellent. Endless Kindler... thank you... for your sacrifice. I will ensure... that your flame... is returned to you.
The Breaking Point#248.dst: Excelente. Encendedora Sin Fin... gracias... por tu sacrificio. Haré... que tu llama... vuelva a ti.
The Breaking Point#248.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#250.src: Ozoth apologises... if it was a bit hot... in there.
The Breaking Point#250.dst: Ozoth se disculpa... si hacía algo de calor... ahí dentro.
The Breaking Point#250.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#251.src: Now, {u}... I was never the best... at the ancient magic... but I hope I have enough skill... to take us the short route back...
The Breaking Point#251.dst: Ahora, {u}... nunca fui el mejor... con la magia antigua... pero espero poder... llevarnos de vuelta por el atajo...
The Breaking Point#251.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#252.src: You have returned! Is there news from {p}? Did the dragon offer aid?
The Breaking Point#252.dst: ¡Habéis vuelto! ¿Hay noticias de {p}? ¿La dragona ofreció ayuda?
The Breaking Point#252.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#253.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Eternal Flame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#253.dst: Sí... Ozoth hizo un gran sacrificio... por la provincia... pero tenemos una Llama Eterna... para el hielo.
The Breaking Point#253.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#254.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Everflame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#254.dst: Así es... Ozoth hizo un gran sacrificio... por la provincia... y tenemos la Llama Eterna... para el hielo.
The Breaking Point#254.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#255.src: Well done... both of you. I will ensure... that the doguns thank her... properly. The dwarves would do well... to do the same.
The Breaking Point#255.dst: Bien hecho... los dos. Haré... que los Doguns le den las gracias... como corresponde. Los enanos harían bien... en imitarlos.
The Breaking Point#255.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#256.src: Yes, yes, but there's no time to worry about that now. Quick, let's get back to the-
The Breaking Point#256.dst: Sí, sí, pero ahora no hay tiempo para eso. Rápido, volvamos a-
The Breaking Point#256.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#257.src: Be wary... of the Elders... Draani. It is unlikely they will react well... after their imprisonment. It is vital... you explain the situation... to them.
The Breaking Point#257.dst: Cuidado... con los Ancianos... Draani. Difícilmente reaccionarán bien... tras su encierro. Es vital... que les expliques... la situación.
The Breaking Point#257.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#258.src: I would join you... both... but the ice is inhospitable... to my kind. I wish the both of you... the best of luck.
The Breaking Point#258.dst: Os acompañaría... a los dos... pero el hielo es inhóspito... para los míos. Os deseo... mucha suerte.
The Breaking Point#258.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#259.src: ...right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#259.dst: ...ya. Sí. Bueno, no hay forma de esquivarlo. Ven, {u}. Hay que descongelar a los Ancianos y lograr que nos escuchen. Trae la llama; te veré en la Cámara.
The Breaking Point#259.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#260.src: ... right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#260.dst: ... ya. Sí. Bueno, no hay manera de esquivarlo. Ven, {u}. Debemos descongelar a los Ancianos y lograr que nos escuchen. Trae la llama; te espero en la Cámara.
The Breaking Point#260.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#261.src: Return to the Dogun Vault at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to free the Dogun Elders.
The Breaking Point#261.dst: Vuelve a la Cámara Dogun en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para liberar a los Ancianos Dogun.

The Breaking Point#262.src: Well then, what are we waiting for! Let's free these elders, shall we?
The Breaking Point#262.dst: ¡Pues bien, a qué esperamos! Liberemos a estos Ancianos, ¿no?
The Breaking Point#262.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#263.src: Just bring the Everflame to each of the cells, and melt through that True Ice.
The Breaking Point#263.dst: Lleva la Llama Eterna a cada celda y funde ese True Ice.
The Breaking Point#263.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#264.src: Excellent! We've done it! Now we just need to explain the situation-...
The Breaking Point#264.dst: ¡Excelente! ¡Lo logramos! Ahora solo falta explicar la situación-...
The Breaking Point#264.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#266.src: ...Ah. I suppose I did not... think this through. Ehm. Elders, I must apo-
The Breaking Point#266.dst: ...Ah. Supongo que no... lo pensé bien. Ejem. Ancianos, debo disculp-
The Breaking Point#266.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#267.src: Dwarf... Hm. The crimes... of your ancestors... must be repaid.
The Breaking Point#267.dst: Enano... Hm. Los crímenes... de tus ancestros... deben pagarse.
The Breaking Point#267.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#268.src: However. We have... heard you speak. We have... learned of... the Protector's state.
The Breaking Point#268.dst: Sin embargo. Hemos... oído lo que decíais. Sabemos... del estado... del Protector.
The Breaking Point#268.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#269.src: We will... settle your debt... later. This situation... is a more pressing... concern. The Protector... must be calmed.
The Breaking Point#269.dst: Tu deuda... la saldaremos... después. Esto... es más... apremiante. Hay que calmar... al Protector.
The Breaking Point#269.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#270.src: ...Yes. You. Human. That was... dragonfire... was it not?
The Breaking Point#270.dst: ...Sí. Tú. Humano. Eso era... fuego de dragón... ¿no?
The Breaking Point#270.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#271.src: Then allow me... to borrow it. Its strength... will allow us... to restore ours. Now... Who now holds... the title... of Chieftain?
The Breaking Point#271.dst: Entonces permíteme... tomarlo prestado. Su fuerza... nos permitirá... recobrar la nuestra. Ahora... ¿Quién ostenta... el título... de jefe?
The Breaking Point#271.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#272.src: A-ah! Paku is now the Dogun Chieftain. He would be at... At Taloka.
The Breaking Point#272.dst: ¡A-ah! Ahora el jefe Dogun es Paku. Estará en... En Taloka.
The Breaking Point#272.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#273.src: Very well... We shall travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#273.dst: Muy bien... Viajaremos... entre llamas... y entre piedra...
The Breaking Point#273.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#274.src: ...The Elders... after all this time... to see you, again... in the flesh...
The Breaking Point#274.dst: ...Los Ancianos... tras tanto tiempo... veros de nuevo... en persona...
The Breaking Point#274.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#275.src: Greetings, Paku. We have much... to discuss. But first... we must travel... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#275.dst: Saludos, Paku. Tenemos mucho... que hablar. Pero antes... debemos ir... ante el Protector.
The Breaking Point#275.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#276.src: Join us... Ineos and Paku. There is... very little time... to waste.
The Breaking Point#276.dst: Venid... Ineos y Paku. Queda... muy poco tiempo... que perder.
The Breaking Point#276.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#277.src: Now, let us travel... (The following part of the line is High Gavellian) Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#277.dst: Ahora, viajemos... (Lo que sigue está en alto gavelliano) Entre llamas... y entre piedra...
The Breaking Point#277.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#278.src: Korzim... my son... join us. The Elders must see... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#278.dst: Korzim... hijo mío... ven. Los Ancianos deben ver... al Protector.
The Breaking Point#278.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#279.src: Iscor... Astal... Desint... it has been... too long. I will come.
The Breaking Point#279.dst: Iscor... Astal... Desint... ha pasado... demasiado. Yo iré.
The Breaking Point#279.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#280.src: Earth and flame... fire and stone... transport us through your form! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#280.dst: Tierra y llama... fuego y piedra... ¡llevadnos a través de vuestra forma! (En alto gavelliano)
The Breaking Point#280.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#282.src: There's no time! I can feel the damned ground cracking beneath my feet, we have to turn to the final option. We've had demolition mages on standby the past few days, our only choice is to-
The Breaking Point#282.dst: ¡No hay tiempo! Noto el maldito suelo agrietarse bajo mis pies; hay que ir a la última opción. Llevamos días con magos de demolición en espera, no queda más que-
The Breaking Point#282.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#283.src: Rhay. Elix. My Elders... have been freed. They are here... to help... the Protector.
The Breaking Point#283.dst: Rhay. Elix. Mis Ancianos... están libres. Han venido... a ayudar... al Protector.
The Breaking Point#283.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#284.src: Join us... brave ones. You will see... that your efforts to save this Province... have not been in vain.
The Breaking Point#284.dst: Venid... valientes. Veréis... que vuestro esfuerzo por salvar la Provincia... no ha sido en vano.
The Breaking Point#284.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#285.src: Flames of the earth... take us to the Great Protector... to make our plea! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#285.dst: Llamas de la tierra... llevadnos ante el Gran Protector... ¡a suplicarle! (En alto gavelliano)
The Breaking Point#285.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#286.src: Travel to the Canyon Colossus at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to calm it.
The Breaking Point#286.dst: Viaja al Canyon Colossus, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], e intenta calmarlo.

The Breaking Point#288.src: Hmph. Foolish dwarves... This is what has come...of your needless war... You are fortunate...to have freed us now...
The Breaking Point#288.dst: Hmf. Enanos necios... A esto ha llevado...vuestra guerra inútil... Suerte tenéis...de habernos liberado...
The Breaking Point#288.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#289.src: Desint... Iscor... I will prepare... the ritual. Defend me... as I do so.
The Breaking Point#289.dst: Desint... Iscor... prepararé... el ritual. Defendedme... entretanto.
The Breaking Point#289.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#290.src: Human. We will pull the Protector... away from the brink. That is all we can do now. All the power... we can muster.
The Breaking Point#290.dst: Humano. Apartaremos al Protector... del abismo. Es cuanto podemos hacer. Toda la fuerza... que reunamos.
The Breaking Point#290.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#291.src: You must enter... these sacred grounds. Battle through it to the end... Knock some sense... into it.
The Breaking Point#291.dst: Debes entrar... en estas tierras sagradas. Lucha hasta el final... Hazle entrar... en razón.
The Breaking Point#291.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#292.src: Adventurer... We are counting...on you. We will try to...support you however we can.
The Breaking Point#292.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#293.src: We'll do the best we can out here! I have some ideas already...
The Breaking Point#293.dst: ¡Aquí fuera haremos lo que podamos! Ya tengo algunas ideas...
The Breaking Point#293.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#294.src: Rhay, this isn't the time. Human. We have your back. You can do this.
The Breaking Point#294.dst: Rhay, no es el momento. Humano. Te cubrimos. Tú puedes.
The Breaking Point#294.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#295.src: You have faced...worse odds before...have you not? You will face them...again.
The Breaking Point#295.dst: Ya te enfrentaste...a cosas peores...¿no? Volverás...a hacerlo.
The Breaking Point#295.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#296.src: It is done. Desint... Iscor... Take your postions. We must... hold it back.
The Breaking Point#296.dst: Hecho. Desint... Iscor... A vuestros puestos. Debemos... contenerlo.
The Breaking Point#296.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#297.src: Great Protector, lord of stone, hear our burning call. Your fury clouds your vision, your anger burns and twists our home. (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#297.dst: Gran Protector, señor de la piedra, oye nuestra ardiente llamada. Tu furia te ciega; tu ira quema nuestro hogar. (En alto gavelliano)
The Breaking Point#297.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#298.src: We, the doguns, who now hold the final flame of a fallen god... We will hold you back. We will keep this land intact! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#298.dst: Nosotros, los Doguns, que guardamos la última llama de un dios caído... Te contendremos. ¡Salvaremos esta tierra! (En alto gavelliano)
The Breaking Point#298.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#299.src: We will... hold it from here... human. Now... go! We will not... be able to hold it... for long...
The Breaking Point#299.dst: Lo contendremos... desde aquí... humano. ¡Ahora... ve! No podremos... retenerlo... mucho tiempo...
The Breaking Point#299.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#300.src: This crystal...will let you harness...our flame. Use it...to break through...its defenses.
The Breaking Point#300.dst: Este cristal...te permitirá manejar...nuestra llama. Úsalo...para romper...sus defensas.
The Breaking Point#300.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#301.src: ... Before you go. I will offer you... these powerful relics. Our people... have held them for... longer than I have lived. They may... help you on your quest.
The Breaking Point#301.dst: ... Antes de irte. Te ofrezco... estas poderosas reliquias. Mi pueblo... las guarda... desde antes de que yo naciera. Quizá... te ayuden.
The Breaking Point#301.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#302.src: I cannot give you something as unique as what Paku has offered, but I can still lend you a sum from our treasury. Use it as you must, so long as you can calm that thing. Good luck.
The Breaking Point#302.dst: No puedo darte algo tan único como lo de Paku, pero sí prestarte una suma de nuestro tesoro. Úsala como haga falta, con tal de que calmes a esa cosa. Suerte.
The Breaking Point#302.speaker: King Draani
